facts.fact: Estiene 伸手触碰 Ysabel 的脸颊，感到肌肤 firm、waxy、不冷不热，随即宣布她已死
facts.anchor: The flesh was firm and waxy. It was not cold, but neither was it warm

facts.fact: 一名拿蜡封信纸的中年男子 Girard 从钟下门进入，他才是本场考试病例，Ysabel 不是
facts.anchor: And this man was their exam case, which meant that Ysabel Caudotte was not.

facts.fact: Estiene 坚持在整点结束前谁也不能处理 Caudotte，他们必须继续 Grand Exam
facts.anchor: Nobody can do anything about Caudotte until the hour’s up

facts.fact: Jehan 问出 Girard 在第十一区经营一家肉铺
facts.anchor: You said you own a butcher’s shop in the Eleventh Quarter.

facts.fact: Jehan 诊断 Girard 患的是 hare fever，并说此病在猎人和农人中更常见、夏季更多
facts.anchor: It’s more common in hunters and farmers, and more common in summer.

facts.fact: Jehan 说明 hare fever 有四分之一的概率留下长达一年的 echo-illness
facts.anchor: A one-in-four chance of an echo-illness lasting for as long as a year

facts.fact: Ysabel 死后，许多人预期 Estiene 将以 Dux Scolaris 身份毕业
facts.anchor: a lot of people would now expect to see Estiene graduate as Dux Scolaris

facts.fact: 二年级年终考试中，Ysabel 排第一，Estiene 与 Moyna 分列第二和第三
facts.anchor: come second and third to Ysabel’s first in the end-of-year exams
